mentions.name: Tap
mentions.description: This tool turns browser automation into deterministic programs: a tap is forged once using AI-assisted page inspection, then can be run forever at zero AI cost. It is being built as a Chrome extension with MCP integration so Claude Code and Cursor can use it directly. It also includes doctor/heal functionality — automatic diagnostics that cross-validate what a tap extracts against the page's structured data (JSON-LD, ARIA) to keep automations working as sites change.
mentions.problem: Reliability of browser automation: sites change over time, causing taps/scripts to break.
